title: Gap Fill and Reverse
summary: Of the sessions that filled their opening gap, how often the session went on to close beyond the prior close against the gap's direction — fill-and-reverse rather than fill-and-hold. The denominator is filled gaps only, so this is a second-stage question: it says nothing about whether gaps fill, only about what filling led to. Multiply by the fill rate if you want the share of all gapped sessions instead.

params.name: minGapPct
params.doc: Only gaps at least this large (percent of prior close, absolute).

deltas: an explicitly conditional denominator (filled gaps), stated rather than implied
